verdict.rationale: Anytype publishes a downloadable OpenAPI document at developers.anytype.io/openapi-v2.yaml, with full component schemas and documented error responses. The spec is versioned with dated releases (2025-11-08 and earlier) and synced from the anytype-heart core. The probe's 404s were on doc.anytype.io candidate paths, a different host, so they do not contradict the developer-portal spec. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the openapi-v2.yaml file downloads successfully.
